facts.text: I came to a wedding, and now I'm stacking shelves. At least the snacks are free.
facts.why: Keung never says this and does not stack shelves. He stops the bikers outside, then fights them in and around Elaine's supermarket.
facts.fix: I came for a wedding, and now I'm fighting bikers in the aisles. Please keep my receipt.

facts.text: For Danny, Nancy's little brother, who keeps an eye on the store
